assets.title: Twin-Bell Desk Alarm Clock
assets.description: One original static twin-bell desk alarm clock: a deep upright circular closed-back case with a real front recess, twelve raised solid hour batons and two separate fixed hands on a shared supported spindle. Two outward-tilted bell domes are genuine continuous thick shells with open underside cavities, each seated on its own case-rooted support rod. The central fixed hammer head has positive clearance to both bells. Two splayed feet have finite flat ground patches. Twenty-six named editable closed meshes, five constant fully opaque solid PBR materials, metres, source Z up, front -Y and ground-centre origin. Gold-toned rim and bells, deep jade case, ivory dial and dark solid hands. All visible markings are actual geometry. No text, texture, glass, logo, separate base or surrounding scene. A single fixed display pose only. No timekeeping, alarm sound, ringing motion, clockwork, winding, electricity, accuracy, calibration, mechanical movement, assembly path, load, manufacturing, lifetime or safety performance is modeled or guaranteed. Not a working or calibrated instrument.
